title: fix(app-shell): disabled Explain and Pick in Explain access say an object is missing
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_

Fixes #34865

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

改了什么:Studio「权限解释」(Explain access)面板里,未选对象时灰掉的「解释」按钮和记录「选择」按钮,现在鼠标悬停、键盘 Tab 聚焦、读屏软件三条路都能拿到原因「请先选择对象」。
为什么改:原来两个按钮是原生 disabled,悬停无提示、Tab 跳过、读屏读不到原因;「选择」唯一的 title 就是它自己的名字「Pick」。
风险与回滚:只改显示与可达性,复用已落地的共享包装 `DisabledControlReason`,不改解释请求逻辑;选了对象后两个按钮与原来一样。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AccessExplainPanel.tsx`(两处按钮外包一层 `DisabledControlReason`)→ `AccessExplainPanel.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 describe → `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` / `zh.ts` 各一行新文案。
两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/views/metadata-admin/AccessExplainPanel.test.tsx`,预期全部通过(含新增 2 条)。
需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

With no object chosen, "Explain access" draws Explain and the record Pick disabled, and both were bare disabled buttons: a natively disabled button takes neither hover nor focus, so no tooltip opened, Tab skipped it, and nothing reached the accessibility tree. Pick's only `title` was its own label, "Pick".

Both now take the treatment the closed #32103, #32104 and #32105 gave the same class (`ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason`), by reusing the shared `DisabledControlReason` wrapper from `metadata-admin/inspectors/_shared.tsx` unchanged: a focusable wrapper opens a tooltip with the reason, and the wrapper and the button both point `aria-describedby` at an `sr-only` copy of it. Each button keeps its own name.

- Reason: one new string, `engine.studio.access.explain.needObject` ("Choose an object first" / "请先选择对象"), in the Studio namespace catalogues of `@object-ui/i18n`. Both buttons wait on the same condition, so they share it.
- Explain while a run is in flight gives no reason: its label already says "Explaining…".
- Pick's redundant `title` (equal to its visible label) is dropped, so a native tooltip no longer competes with the reason.
- The disabled predicates are unchanged (`!objectName.trim()`, and `busy ||` for Explain).
- Root changeset: `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, as the prior fix of this class shipped.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the existing harness `AccessExplainPanel.test.tsx`:

- No object: Pick and Explain are disabled and each is described by the reason; Pick carries no `title`; Tab from the record-id input lands on Pick's wrapper, then on Explain's wrapper, each described by the reason, and the tooltip shows it.
- CONTROL: an object typed in, both are plain enabled buttons, with no `aria-describedby`, no `data-disabled-reason` and no `tabindex` on the wrapper.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface: the dispatch fenced `AccessExplainPanel.tsx`, its tests and the root changeset. The reason string has to live in the Studio namespace catalogue, so `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` and `zh.ts` each gain one line, the same place the prior fix of this class put its strings. The shared helper is reused, not edited.

## Verification

Local runs at the head this PR was opened on:

- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` before each push.
- Derived local gate subset, each exit 0: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:type-check-coverage`.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the app-shell vitest file and the UI type-check. Reason: the shared verify lock was held for the whole session by another run of the full app-shell suite, and five timed attempts did not acquire it. This is a declared narrowing; `Test UI` and `Type Check UI` on this PR are the evidence, and the dev report records the outcome.
